# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

{{ site.title }} is a visual journal published at {{ '/' | absolute_url }}. It is a static Jekyll site: no JavaScript, no analytics, no third-party scripts. New writing appears in the journal and in the feed at {{ '/feed.xml' | absolute_url }}.

## Repositories

- [Repositories]({{ '/projects/' | absolute_url }}): {{ site.data.repos.repos | size }} public repositories, with language and last push.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/superposition): the same repositories, including forks and work not listed here.

## Elsewhere

- [Mage](https://superposition.github.io/mage/): field notes on mathematics, information, and the computation that produces them.
- [Telegram](https://t.me/SuprPosition): where to write.
